name: i-rlu
description: Interactive Report layout utility designer for IBM i printer file DDS (SCS/AFPDS)

i-rlu.unitOfMeasure.description: Unit of measure to assume when converting LINE/BOX/BARCODE physical measurements to the preview's character grid. There is no UOM keyword in DDS source — UOM is set on the CRTPRTF command that compiles this file, so I-RLU can't detect it from the source alone. Set this to match what your shop actually passes to CRTPRTF (its own default is *INCH); if you don't know, leave this as inch.

enumDescriptions: Open the designer full-width in the same tab, replacing the split (default) - less cramped, since you don't need the source visible at the same time.
Open the designer in a split column next to the DDS source - lets you see the source and the visual designer side by side.
Open the designer and automatically pop it out into its own window.
i-rlu.designerOpenColumn.description: Where I-RLU opens the Report Designer, for "I-RLU: Open Report Designer" and when opening a .pf/.prtf/.rlu file via the editor selector.

i-rlu.trackSourceModifications.description: Report Designer: when a keyword/field/record edit changes an existing source line, comment out the original line instead of overwriting it (so its history stays in the file), and tag the new/changed line with the Modification tag (columns 81-90, past what the DDS compiler reads). This is the DEFAULT for newly opened designer sessions - it can also be toggled per-session from the Properties panel without changing this setting.

i-rlu.modificationTag.description: Report Designer: default 10-character tag written to columns 81-90 of any new/changed source line when modification tracking is on. Only used as the STARTING value for the Properties panel's own session-only Modification tag box - editing it there doesn't change this setting.
